training_stages.name: strict_ablation
training_stages.policy: Keep the locked parameter-only threshold and effective close quantity fixed. Compare the native retracement=0 passive grid-limit close with native retracement>0 trailing MFE closes. Positive giveback values are static fractions of threshold_base_pct, not fractions of the state-dependent effective threshold.

training_stages.name: narrow_joint_search
training_stages.policy: Only around a positive strict-ablation winner, vary close threshold, giveback, and close quantity over a predeclared narrow neighborhood.

trailing_martingale_static_grid.comparability_requirement: close_threshold_we_weight must be nonzero. At zero, the native grid branch forces a full close while the trailing branch honors close_qty_pct, so the quantity-matched comparison is undefined.

validation_lock: Each fold writes its selected MFE parameters and exact parameter-only comparator before opening that fold's validation window.
interpretation_boundary: This is a comparison of two official trailing_martingale close mechanisms: CloseGrid at retracement=0 versus CloseTrailing at retracement>0. It is not a same-mechanism one-field ablation. Retracement volatility weights remain zero in this study, so conclusions apply to the tested static giveback range and must not be generalized to every dynamic trailing configuration.
training_selection_priority: Feasibility first, then total hard-threshold violation, worst primary-track MDD, worst 1% drawdown mean, recovery duration, ADG, and deterministic parameter hash.

enablement_rule.fold_non_worse_rule: The selected MFE candidate's worst primary-track validation MDD must be no greater than its exact parameter-only comparator in at least two of three folds.
enablement_rule.decision: Enable MFE for final training only when it satisfies every hard condition and its aggregate OOS tuple is lexicographically better than the exact parameter-only comparator. Otherwise keep MFE disabled.

holdout_policy: The final unseen holdout cannot change MFE enablement or its search neighborhood.
